enforcement.when_enforced: The item has per-route evidence. model_would_hide=false then REFUSES the caller's hide and the item stays visible.
enforcement.when_not_enforced: The item has no per-route evidence. The caller's own decision stands and this report only records what the model would have said - the deliberate choice that keeps legitimate structural hides working.
enforcement.note: model_would_hide counts what the model concluded, not what happened: on an item with no evidence the caller may still have hidden it.

note: model_would_hide=false means the evidence this site acted on does not by itself support removing the item. Where evidence exists that conclusion is enforced; see the enforcement block.

hmac_key.note: A null key_id here means the secret was not in the environment that produced this report - which is the normal state for a local run, since the secret lives in the CI environment. It is not a failure: without a key every keyed field reports 'unknown', and 'unknown' can never hide anything.
